notes.title: Update to V2.0
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I am thrilled to announce a major update for NUDOMATIC! Here's what I have prepared for you:

🌍 New Event Map Management:
Navigate through a completely redesigned map with even more intuitive and immersive event management!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/94d98ef8936928e85fd78a24ff33d32cc988188b.gif[/img]

🎬 Animated Scenes:
I have added animated scenes that will bring U's adventures to life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/026f8842a4be52a72558c60e6997a38a0ba3a2b7.gif[/img]

👤 3D Characters:
For the first time, some characters will appear in 3D in the gallery. 
Discover more realistic and detailed character models.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/b45466e9e5dbe630683f7b6e83ca9ef39a36a95f.gif[/img]

This update is the result of hard work, and I hope you will enjoy it as much as I enjoyed creating it. I look forward to hearing your feedback and seeing how you explore these new features!

Thank you for your continued support and passion for NUDOMATIC. See you in the game to discover all these new features!

Best regards,

Ultrabend

notes.title: Announcement of V2.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/2039ed83d73f678ae4ab1d8339113bb478839164.jpg[/img]

Following the favorable feedback, I couldn't leave the Nudomatic on the shelf !
That's why it will have a V2 that will bring some sexy changes ; )
The update is scheduled for the end of summer, unless it gets too hot Oo!

The Megacity map is being redesigned to increase the number of scenes and pinups to undress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/94d98ef8936928e85fd78a24ff33d32cc988188b.gif[/img]

In the gallery, some pinups will have a 3D view of their charming anatomies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/b45466e9e5dbe630683f7b6e83ca9ef39a36a95f.gif[/img]

Animations will punctuate the end of the small narrative circles of some of our friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/026f8842a4be52a72558c60e6997a38a0ba3a2b7.gif[/img]

In the meantime, the Nudomatic will be available during the summer sales !

Enjoy your vacation by undressing the cyber-pinups!

See you !

notes.title: NUDOMATIC is now available !
notes.notes:
After a year of solo work, I'm pleased to bring you NUDOMATIC !
A game based on pinups of the future !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44003354/49dbdf3f906b0b04300ea6e83545da064951253e.jpg[/img]

In a few figures NUDOMATIC is :

50 levels + extra events
22 womens to undress
The game is currently available in 3 languages English, French and Russian

I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I enjoyed making it !

Ultrabend

notes.title: Update and Steam NeoFest
notes.notes:
[b]ULTRACORP[/b] is pleased to announce that [b]Nudomatic[/b] will be present at [b]Steam Neo Fest[/b], so this is a good opportunity to update the Nudomatic demo.

What's more, development is progressing very well, with a potential release date at the end of the year.

So if you don't know [b]Nudomatic[/b], go ahead and try out the demo, and if not, let yourself be tempted!

And don't forget to add it to your [b]Wishlist[/b]!
